add_element_features_to_dataframe: add element property features to a pandas DataFrame from a chemical composition column using matminer featurizers
convert_composition_strings_to_features: convert chemical composition strings in a DataFrame column into weighted average element property features like atomic mass and radius
featurize_xrf_compositions: featurize XRF composition data by extracting mean element properties such as electronegativity, atomic mass, and Mendeleev number
review_add_el_features_function: review the add_el_features function that extracts element property features from composition strings in a pandas DataFrame
refactor_add_el_features_for_custom_prop: refactor the add_el_features function to support custom element property features beyond the default matminer preset
